title: task.agent.json — spec-harness task state
description: Machine-readable state for one ClickUp task. Normative field list: docs/agents/SharedRules.md §6.

clickupUrl.$comment: Tracker task URL. Field name is historical (ClickUp); the URL shape is injected from harness.config.json → tracker.urlPattern, so any tracker works without renaming existing task data.

layer.$comment: Allowed values injected from harness.config.json → layers. A FE-only project declares ["frontend"]; a monorepo or BE project declares its own.

splitInto.description: Task IDs this task was split into. Required when status=split: a task that exhausted the retry budget is a task that was too big, and "split" without children is just a rename for giving up.

branch.description: Conventional branch name per ProjectRules §3 — same slug as docsPath. Deliberately not pattern-enforced: projects change their branch convention over time and older tasks must stay valid.

branchActual.description: Optional. Real working branch when it differs from the conventional `branch` (user-managed branch exception, SharedRules §3).

parentTaskId.description: Optional. Parent ClickUp task id, empty string when none.

subTaskKey.description: Optional. Distinct slug disambiguating multiple folders that share one ClickUp taskId (separate sub-bugs of the same ClickUp item). Required to be distinct per folder when a taskId is reused.

complexity.description: Complexity vector (Agents.md §5.1). taskComplexity is DERIVED from it by formula §5.1.1 — the validator recomputes and rejects a mismatch.

counts.description: Measured numbers the vector was scored from. The validator cross-checks them against the vector, so they are evidence, not decoration (Agents.md 5.1).

existingTests.$comment: Test files already covering the code. 0 => testing >= 1.

questions.description: Things that cannot be built without an answer. Empty => uncertainty 0; non-empty => uncertainty >= 1. Writing the list is the check.

splitEvaluated.description: Required at effort >= 9, or scope 2 + uncertainty 2: the child task IDs, or why this cannot ship in parts (Agents.md 5.1.4).

docsPath.$comment: pattern injected from harness.config.json → tasksDir + groupPrefix

agents.description: Per-role status. Six canonical FE roles required; extra roles allowed.

outcome.description: What actually happened after the task shipped. This is the only ground truth the harness gets: everything else is an estimate made before the work. Filled when the task closes (status=done), by whoever closes it.

escapedBugs.description: Bugs found after this task left the harness (QC, staging, production). >0 means the gates passed something they should have caught.

reworkAfterReview.description: Times the task came back for code changes after status=reviewing (review comments, MR rejections).

note.description: One line: what the estimate missed, in plain words.

attempts.description: How many times each stage actually ran. Optimal is 1; >1 means a gate sent it back. This is the harness's Step Efficiency signal — rework is measured, not estimated.

telemetry.description: One entry per stage dispatch: which tier ran, how long, and how many input tokens it cost. No vendor usage object — just an integer the CLI already reports. Without it the harness cannot see its own cost: the per-stage rule floor is multiplied by every stage of every task, and a bloated kernel shows up only on the monthly bill, never attributable to a cause.

model.description: What the CLI actually called it, e.g. "sonnet". Empty when the CLI cannot route per-subagent.

inputTokens.description: Input tokens this dispatch consumed, as reported by the CLI. Omit when the CLI does not report it.

allOf.$comment: Branch type must match implementer: feature/hotfix => fe-implementer active; bugfix => fe-fix active.
